The discrepancy is explicitly held; the Registry retains the raw line and no alternate-key or product-code alias is added.

discrepancies: Every retained notice is byte-identical to its source physical line and the committed upstream legal resource, except that Occult Mysteries is stored trimmed. No source wording was corrected. Inner Sea Races has two spaces before Jessica Price; Lords of Chaos and Lost Cities lack terminal periods; Lost Cities has a title-terminal period and publisher-terminal period before Authors:. Misfit Monsters Redeemed literally says Paizo Publushing, LLC; the apparent publisher spelling discrepancy is independently held. Occult Bestiary literally names Joe Homes; no personal-name correction is inferred. Occult Mysteries ends in one U+0020: the immutable ticket key hashes the trimmed line while textSha256 hashes the raw line. Under the owner's notice-normalization policy (2026-10-08) the Registry stores the trimmed text, so its hash equals the key; the raw line stays in the upstream block and its hash in Registry provenance. Its stored text equals the unreviewed PZO9269 seed, also stored trimmed under the same policy; that seed's review status and its pending AoN Numeria/complete-chain review remain unchanged. Literal years, Copyright versus ©, publisher names, contributor labels and punctuation are retained. No printed correction or complete book chain is established.

Misfit Monsters Redeemed literally says Copyright 2010, Paizo Publushing, LLC; Authors:. Adjacent notices spell Publishing, but that does not establish a corrected notice for this book. The apparent publisher spelling discrepancy is separately held; no guessed replacement is recorded.

Mythic Realms uses © 2013, Paizo Publishing, LLC; Numeria, Land of Fallen Stars uses © 2014, Paizo Inc.; and Occult Bestiary uses © 2015, Paizo Inc.;. Occult Bestiary literally names Joe Homes and Stephen Radney-MacFarland; no personal-name correction or alias is inferred.

Occult Mysteries literally uses © 2014, Paizo Inc.; and names Jason Bulmahn, Crystal Frasier, Jim Groves, Brandon Hodge, James Jacobs, Erik Mona, F. Wesley Schneider, and Jerome Virnich. The raw physical line has one trailing U+0020 and SHA-256 75497a028ee2f7090b17cf09a7613cc0e5a892a2d25422188d948a4f7e319428. Its trimmed text hashes to the supplied 7da6fc0fb447cd40742ecedfe25750c86f062b7aa5c0cc457ed0d622d0bff22d suffix; no exact physical-line occurrence of that trimmed hash exists. Under the owner's notice-normalization policy (2026-10-08) the Registry stores the trimmed text, and the key-normalization hold is released; the raw-line hash stays in Registry provenance and the upstream block keeps the raw line. The stored text equals the unreviewed PZO9269 seed, also stored trimmed and still unreviewed and unaliased; the isolated line does not resolve the known AoN Numeria error or prove the complete inherited chain.

Occult Realms uses © 2015, Paizo Inc.; and Osirion, Legacy of Pharaohs uses © 2014, Paizo Publishing, LLC;. Names including Thomas M. Reed and Jonathan H. Keith, years and contributor punctuation remain exact; no printed verification is inferred.
